name: Flocks
description: Migrating bird flocks that signal the changing seasons, and huntable geese that land on lakes. Install on both client and server. Sounds: Joost van Bruggen, Jonathon Jongsma and Marie-Lan Tay Pamart (xeno-canto, CC BY-SA), Aubrey John Williams (British Library, CC BY-SA 4.0), Sharad Apte (CC BY-SA 4.0), Lawrence Shove (British Library, CC BY-SA 4.0), Bubulcus (CC BY 3.0), Wikimalte (CC BY-SA 4.0), Extemporalist, V. P. Volkov and the Sonothèque ADVL (CC0); see CREDITS.md.
